title: AgentFileOps Connection Descriptor
description: Canonical connection metadata for AgentFileOps remote file operations. Credentials are referenced, never embedded.

sftp_home.description: Path representing account home in the SFTP namespace; may be '.' for a chroot-like namespace.

shell_home.description: Path representing account home in the shell namespace when shell access and safe mapping exist.

aliases.description: Named location bookmarks relative to the connection home unless explicitly modeled otherwise.

commands.description: Conservatively detected fixed shell-command capabilities such as cp, mv, or sha256sum.

credential_ref.description: Reference to secret material; raw credentials are not allowed in the protocol object.
